single_change.old: AO6 safe-Lab source context is recomputed independently from colour-only, cheap-physics and full-physics arm inputs
single_change.new: compile one safe-Lab source context from the original source after the frozen pointwise density stage, then reuse that exact context for colour-only, cheap-physics and full-physics anchor application

execution_order: run public safe-Lab context equivalence tests
run constant-field and impulse mechanism smoke
only if smoke passes, run the frozen 16-photo ablation twice
only if automatic gates pass, refresh three independently randomized blind rounds

branch_rule.context_equivalence_fail: close implementation and preserve existing AO6 colour-only output
branch_rule.mechanism_smoke_fail: close source-context candidate without full photographic rerender
branch_rule.automatic_fail: retain colour-only AO6 and preserve physical primitives separately
branch_rule.severe_or_preference_fail: retain colour-only AO6 and preserve physical primitives separately
branch_rule.complete_pass: retain combined as a development challenger and open separately frozen complete-profile ablation; do not change production default

claim_ceiling: generic physical-inspired developed-spatial plus source-context-fixed AO6-like display-look ablation; not complete film image formation, stock response, calibration, scanner profile or product promotion
